description: AI project risk register — Builds a project risk register from a plain description (project=, optional context= and count= 3-15, default 8): each risk gets category, cause, event, impact, likelihood and severity 1-5, strategy (avoid / mitigate / transfer / accept), mitigation, contingency, owner role and an early-warning trigger. Scores (likelihood x severity), LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL ratings, sorting, a 5x5 heat map, category counts, overall risk level and quality flags (vague mitigation, no owner, accepting a high risk) are computed offline, plus a ready-to-paste Markdown table. Example: /v1/ai/risk-register?project=Migrate our billing database from MySQL to Postgres over a weekend Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

project.description: Migrate our billing database from MySQL to Postgres over a weekend

name: ai_risk_register
